lines.text: God says He brought Israel out of the land of Egypt and tells them to have no other gods before Him.
God forbids Israel to make an idol or bow down to it, for He is a jealous God.
God tells Israel to keep the Sabbath on the eighth day, because He rested on the seventh day after creating everything.
God commands Israel to honor their father and mother, and not to murder, commit adultery, steal, bear false witness or covet.
The people tremble at the thunder and smoke, so they ask Aaron to speak to them instead of God.
